recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It closes the remaining stale narrative wording tied to the seed issue family while preserving the already-correct StructureDefinition cardinality; no further core source change is recommended for FHIR-22631.
issue_request: FHIR-22631 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request asking that CommunicationRequest.sender, renamed to CommunicationRequest.informationProvider by GF#22626, support multiple disclosing sources; the final resolution was to change informationProvider cardinality to 0..*.
initial_application: Commit 98ffe585bc9d5fa3f398e0cfe65b1cab8c5e9527 applied GF#22631 to the old CommunicationRequest spreadsheet by changing informationProvider from 0..1 to 0..* and adding the issue note. The later source rework preserved that in source/communicationrequest/structuredefinition-CommunicationRequest.xml, where informationProvider now has max="*".
additional_context: CommunicationRequest is active and approved in source/fhir.ini. The related GF#22626 rename, later Endpoint/Group target additions, and the already-audited FHIR-26951 clarification mean the notes page should use the current informationProvider element and current target-profile lists. Corrected Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/communicationrequest/communicationrequest-notes.xml to refer to CommunicationRequest.informationProvider instead of CommunicationRequest.sender and to include the current Endpoint and Group target-profile additions for provider/recipient wording. The authoritative StructureDefinition cardinality was left unchanged because it already has max="*".
